# keyfactor_pam_provider (Data Source)

Reads an existing Keyfactor Command PAM Provider by name or integer ID. Parameter values are not exposed because secret values cannot be recovered from the server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a PAM provider by name
data "keyfactor_pam_provider" "by_name" {
  identifier = "My Thycotic Provider"
}

# Look up a PAM provider by integer ID
data "keyfactor_pam_provider" "by_id" {
  identifier = "1"
}

# Reference a managed provider resource via the data source
resource "keyfactor_pam_provider" "example" {
  name             = "My Provider"
  provider_type_id = "c09bbfa5-a081-4194-9dd2-31f3cc3fabcc"
}

data "keyfactor_pam_provider" "example" {
  identifier = keyfactor_pam_provider.example.name
}

output "provider_type" {
  value = data.keyfactor_pam_provider.example.provider_type_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identifier` (String) Name or integer ID of the PAM provider to look up.

### Read-Only

- `area` (Number) Area (zone) integer identifier for this PAM provider.
- `id` (Number) Integer ID of the PAM provider.
- `name` (String) Name of the PAM provider.
- `provider_type_id` (String) GUID of the PAM provider type.
- `provider_type_name` (String) Name of the PAM provider type.
- `remote` (Boolean) Whether the PAM provider runs remotely.
